transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess… I haven’t really been myself. I don’t do much anymore. Stopped hiking, coaching, playing guitar… I don’t really call people back.

Some days I just sit in my rental for hours, knowing I should do things, but I can’t seem to get started.
Do you feel down or depressed most of the day, more days than not?
I don’t know if I’d call it depressed. I’m just… kind of flat most days, I guess. Hard to say.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy, like hiking, coaching, or playing guitar?

Yeah… I guess I have. I don’t hike anymore, or coach, or really pick up the guitar. I don’t call people back much either. Mostly I just sit around in that rental, knowing I should do something, but… I can’t get started.
Do you often feel tired or like you don’t have energy, even if you haven’t done much physically?
Yeah… I guess so. It’s not like I’m doing anything, but I still feel… drained. Mostly I just sit there in the rental, knowing I should get up and do something, and I just don’t.
Do you find yourself feeling guilty or worthless, maybe thinking that you’re a failure or that you’ve let people down?
I don’t know… not really like that, I guess. I don’t sit there thinking “I’m worthless” or anything. Maybe I feel like I should be doing more, but… I don’t know.
How long have you been feeling this way, with low energy and not doing the things you used to enjoy?
It’s been… a while. Since I moved into that smaller rental after the divorce, I guess. About a year and a couple months. Things kind of started coming apart then.
Do you feel down or sad most of the day, nearly every day?
I don’t know… I wouldn’t say sad most of the day. It’s more like… empty or just not really there, I guess. Hard to explain.
Do you ever notice that your movements or speech are slower than usual, or that you feel restless and can't sit still?

Yeah… I guess restless. On patrol it got bad sometimes. I’d start moving before I really thought—crouching behind counters, waving people back, pacing the same path over and over. Sometimes I’d repeat what someone said, just to… check it. Staff noticed. They looked scared.
Have you felt down or sad most of the time, nearly every day, for at least two years?
I’m not sure. Two years… that feels like a long stretch. I don’t think I’d say sad nearly every day like that. It’s more… I don’t know. Hard to pin down.
Have you had days where you felt down or sad most of the time, nearly every day, for as long as two years?
I don’t really know. I can’t say it’s been like that for two years straight… I don’t keep track of it that way.
Have you had periods where you felt down or low most days, and those periods lasted for at least two years?
I don’t think I can say that. I’ve had low stretches, sure, but… two years is too specific. I’m not sure.
Have you had days where most of the time you felt down or depressed, and if so, did those days add up to at least two years in a row?
I don’t know. I wouldn’t say I can add it up like that… not two years in a row. I’ve had bad days, but I haven’t really tracked it.
Have you had days where you felt down or depressed most of the time, and if so, did those days add up to at least two years total, even if not in a row?
I’m not sure. I mean, I’ve felt low at times, but adding it up like that… I don’t really know.
Looking back over the past few years, have there been times when you felt down or depressed most days, even if not every day, that together added up to at least two years?
I can’t really say that it added up to two years. I’ve had times where I felt low, but… I don’t keep track of it like that. So I’m not sure.
Over the past two years, have you had days where you felt down or depressed most of the time, and did those days happen often enough that they were the majority of days in a 2-year period?
I don’t think I can say it was the majority of days. I’ve had low days, sure, but… I’m not sure it was like that over two years.
Over the past two years, have you had days where you felt down or depressed most of the time, and were those days frequent enough that they made up more than half of the days in that two-year period?
I don’t really know. I mean, I’ve had days like that, but saying it was more than half the days over two years… I can’t say that.
Over the past two years, have you had days where you felt down or depressed most of the time, and were those days frequent enough that they made up most days in any 2-year period?
I don’t really have a clear answer for that. I’ve had days where I felt low, but I can’t say it was most days over any two-year stretch.
Over the past two years, have you had days where you felt down or depressed most of the time, and were those days frequent enough that they made up the majority of days in any two-year period?
I don’t know… I’ve said, I’ve had low days, but I can’t really measure it like that. I wouldn’t say I know it was the majority of days.
Over the past two years, have you felt down or depressed most of the time on most days, to the point where it was a regular part of your day for most days?
I’m not sure I’d put it that way. I’ve had times I felt down, yeah, but I can’t really say it was most days or like a regular part of every day.
